basis: User delegated continuous TODO execution and actual EST GPU validation; source and deployment independently reviewed.
prior_job_disposition: Confirmed owned PENDING, cancelled with controller/state/name/user filters; final CANCELLED, elapsed zero, no allocated TRES, no S0 marker.
decision_cost: Replace obsolete queued d99 diagnostic with reviewed final source; this can reset queue age but avoids obsolete GPU work and duplicate preflight allocation.
failure_policy: Preserve job subtree and start marker. No automatic recovery if the staged evidence was moved; independently review any subsequent attempt.
